requestOutcomes: Map.ir homepage, vector style JSON, and viewer JavaScript returned HTTP 200 and were inspected. ssaa.ir and kateb.ir timed out; www.ssaa.ir and iransmartmap.ir failed DNS resolution. No credentials, login, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe field request, or TLS exception was used.
